findings.text: The landed change turns this pre-existing test red at head (logs/head_single_checks.log: admission returns launched [] and failed ['r-own-path']), because its monkeypatched create sets worktree on the pointer while the pointer is still phase starting, and the new predicate reads a starting pointer naming a tree as a live claim. The product behaviour is correct, since dispatch_claims.py:906 publishes the claim with no worktree before the tree is cut, so a real launch never names its own tree; but the test's premise now contradicts plan section 5, and landing this commit leaves the routing-importing arm with one added failure. The repair is one line in that helper, leaving the phase queued or not naming the tree before the create, in a file outside this node's write scope.

orientation_base_sha (line 2) and baseline_suite.revision (line 17) both record e9805b3a4cb362516dc5bc3f14e880c7f70eaec1, one character off the reviewed head's actual parent e9805b3a4cb362516dc5bc3f14e880c9f70eaec1 (git log -1 --format=%P, and tree-snapshot.json in the same run directory agree on the latter); the cited value resolves to no object, so the base arm's revision cannot be checked from the record even though its scratch tree's routing.py verifies identical to the true base.

_launch_pointer_worktrees copies the loop body of _live_pointer_worktrees at :1091, differing only in the skip predicate, instead of extending the owner with that predicate as a parameter; the repository already carries a second variant of the same claim scan at recovery_watch.py:172, and this makes a third.

item_verdicts.call_sites: The changed reads are reached only through dispatch: reckon/crew/dispatch.py:2742 cuts the tree under LAUNCH_RUN_ID, routing.py:2237 reaches _stale_launch_tree_refusal, and routing.py:2240 reaches _remove_worktree, whose guard at :2278 raises on a live claim.
item_verdicts.diff: One commit, b1cfbd7d302a, three files, 265 insertions and 6 deletions against e9805b3a4c9f: routing.py gains _own_pointer_yields_its_tree and _launch_pointer_worktrees and switches the two launch-decision reads, the new test adds four cases, and the fragment records the arms.
item_verdicts.done_when: The four cases and the negative control are present and green (logs/after_committed.log 4 passed, logs/negative-control.log 2 failed EXIT=1), but the done_when's third clause, that the routing-importing test files add no failure against the base revision, is unmet: logs/head_routing.log lists 4 failures where logs/base_failing_files.log lists 3, the extra being tests/test_a_successful_launch_is_recorded.py::test_a_queued_request_does_not_hold_its_own_launch_path.
item_verdicts.goal: The node's goal is that a second launch of one run never releases the tree its first launch holds; reckon/crew/routing.py:1121, :2175 and :2278 land it, and the first launch's pointer now reads as a claim once it names its tree, which is the destruction the plan's Why describes.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read in full; it records the four gate arms with their logs, the five pytest-timeout errors and their re-run, the added failure under outside_scope, and the negative control, but its orientation_base_sha and baseline_suite.revision carry e9805b3a4cb362516dc5bc3f14e880c7f70eaec1, which resolves to no object.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The manifest declares reckon/crew/routing.py, the new test, the evidence fragment and a figures directory; the diff touches the first three and nothing else, and the fragment path matches the declaration exactly.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_second_launch_keeps_a_live_worktree.py:93-103 asserts the refusal names the run, keeps the tree's inode and leaves _trash empty, all read from the filesystem rather than round-tripped from the inputs, and logs/negative-control.log shows the working and starting cases red with the predicate mutated; the queued and dead-worker cases are the reverse direction and are only exercised green.
justifications.evidence: The gate was run and recorded, but the plan's own measure is unmet: logs/head_routing.log reports 4 failures against logs/base_failing_files.log's same 3 ids plus tests/test_a_successful_launch_is_recorded.py::test_a_queued_request_does_not_hold_its_own_launch_path only at head, and the recorded after_suite covers the new file alone rather than the population baseline_suite ran.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/routing.py:1103-1150 follows the module's private-helper idiom with a mechanism docstring and no plan, sprint or ticket identifier in a name or comment, and the local import of local_liveness matches the module's existing lazy-import usage.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/routing.py:1121 adds the launch-side claim view and :2175 and :2278 are the only two reads switched to it, with gc, _save_and_release_worktree and promotion release still on _live_pointer_worktrees at :1419 and in those modules, exactly as plan section 5 asks.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/routing.py:1134 re-implements the scan body of _live_pointer_worktrees at :1091 rather than extending it with the skip predicate, so the repository now carries a third copy of the claim scan beside recovery_watch.py:172.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --stat b1cfbd7d302a changes exactly reckon/crew/routing.py, tests/test_a_second_launch_keeps_a_live_worktree.py and docs/evidence/fragments/a-queued-request-is-checked-when-queued/a-second-launch-of-a-run-never-releases-the-tree-its-first.html, and all three are inside the manifest's declared write paths.
